ticket.subject: Downgrade not reflected on our bill
ticket.body_text:
Good morning,

After switching down to the Starter plan, we expected a prorated credit, but invoice INV-2026-9635 shows the old Business plan price.

The plan page in the settings shows the new plan correctly. Your pricing page says plan changes are prorated.

A reply in the next few days would be great. Can you apply the prorated credit to our next invoice?

Best regards,
Hanna Brandt
account manager, Ottervale Software
